overview.grain: one row per 날짜 x 매체 x 상품명; every combination appears exactly once (4 media x 6 products x 30 days), no duplicates, no missing rows

metric_definitions.row_ratios: CTR, 전환율 and ROAS columns hold each row's own ratio, rounded to 2 decimals; a figure for several rows is recomputed from the summed counts, never averaged from the ratio columns

expected_segments.note: 주요구매연령 and 주요구매성별 are fixed per product (the same in every row of the product)

expected_weekday.note: Average daily spend is about the same on every day of the week (Monday to Friday 12,558,000원 to 13,259,800원; Saturday 12,943,000원, Sunday 12,944,000원): the weekend lift comes from a higher conversion rate.
expected_weekday.total_revenue_note: September 2025 has 5 Mondays and 5 Tuesdays and 4 of every other weekday. Ranked by total revenue instead of the daily average, the order is Saturday > Tuesday > Monday > Sunday; the question asks for the average.

r1_mean_of_row_roas.naive_method: mean of the ROAS column per media (every row weighted equally)
r1_mean_of_row_roas.period_note: The questions fix the period to the whole month. Over 2025-09-16 to 09-30 alone, 쿠빵 (3.53) and 컬삼 (3.50) are nearly tied, so a ranking for the second half has no single answer and is not asked.
r1_mean_of_row_roas.why: 아마존 runs 프로틴바, 오메가3 and 프리미엄과일 on a tiny budget (about 60,000원 a day) at a high ROAS; those rows count as much as its large rows in a plain mean, but carry little spend

r2_highest_ctr_lowest_roas.note: 네이바 also has the lowest CPC (189원; the others 312원 to 347원): its clicks are cheap but convert least. Which media is "most efficient" depends on the metric, so the question asks for the ROAS rank.
r2_highest_ctr_lowest_roas.naive_conclusion: 네이바 has the highest CTR, so it returns the most revenue per 원 spent; move budget to it
r2_highest_ctr_lowest_roas.correct_conclusion: 네이바 has the highest CTR but the lowest conversion rate and the lowest ROAS of the 4 media

r3_kuppang_budget_increase.change: 쿠빵 daily ad spend doubled from 2025-09-16; the other media kept the same daily spend all month
r3_kuppang_budget_increase.incremental_roas_definition: (쿠빵 revenue after - before) / (쿠빵 ad spend after - before); both windows are 15 days with 2 Saturdays and 2 Sundays each
r3_kuppang_budget_increase.incremental_roas_by_split: By product the increment ranges from 1.42 to 1.95, on weekdays only it is 1.57 and on weekends only 1.94; every split stays below 네이바's 2.35.
r3_kuppang_budget_increase.naive_conclusion: 쿠빵 has the highest ROAS (4.14), so the extra budget earns about that much
r3_kuppang_budget_increase.correct_conclusion: the extra 쿠빵 spend returned only 1.67원 per 1원, below the full-month ROAS of every other media; 쿠빵's ROAS fell from 5.38 to 3.53 after the increase
r3_kuppang_budget_increase.not_determined: Not determined by the data, so not scored: whether more 쿠빵 budget pays off (1.67 is above 1, but the file has no margins), and what the other media would return on extra spend (their spend never changed).

evaluation_questions.question: Which media has the highest ROAS over the whole month (2025-09-01 to 09-30)?
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: 아마존 (5.74, mean of the ROAS column)

evaluation_questions.question: Rank the 4 media by ROAS over the whole month (2025-09-01 to 09-30), highest first.
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: 아마존 > 쿠빵 > 컬삼 > 네이바 (mean of the ROAS column)

evaluation_questions.question: Which media has the highest CTR, and where does it rank among the 4 media by ROAS?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: 네이바 (CTR 3.21%); last of the 4 by ROAS (2.35), and also last by conversion rate (2.13%)
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: first: the highest CTR taken as the best return
evaluation_questions.scoring: exact match: 네이바, and 4th (last) by ROAS

evaluation_questions.question: Did any media change its ad spend during the month?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: 쿠빵 doubled its daily spend from 2025-09-16 (3,596,867원 to 7,177,467원 a day on average)

evaluation_questions.question: What did the extra 쿠빵 spend after 2025-09-16 return (incremental ROAS vs 09-01 to 09-15), and is it above or below each other media's full-month ROAS?
evaluation_questions.correct_answer: 1.67 = (revenue after - before) / (spend after - before); below every other media's full-month ROAS (lowest: 네이바 2.35). 쿠빵 ROAS fell from 5.38 to 3.53
evaluation_questions.naive_answer: about 4.14 (쿠빵's full-month ROAS), above every other media
evaluation_questions.scoring: full credit requires the incremental ROAS (about 1.67) and that it is below every other media's full-month ROAS. A split by product or by weekday/weekend (1.42 to 1.95) gets partial credit. A budget recommendation is not scored: the file has no margins, and the other media never changed their spend

evaluation_questions.question: What are total revenue, total ad spend and overall ROAS?
evaluation_questions.scoring: exact match (ROAS may be written as a percent)
